title: Elo Momentum + Calibration ECE Tracking for NBA Feature Engine
source: WebSearch: uncertainty-aware NBA prediction 2026 (MDPI, Scientific Reports)
motivation: 2026 paper achieved Brier 0.199 (LR) and 0.202 (XGBoost) vs our best 0.22126. Gap = 0.022. Key techniques: rolling Elo differential, calibration ECE/MCE, uncertainty-aware features.

proposed_features.name: elo_diff_pregame
proposed_features.rationale: Elo diff is top SHAP feature in 2025 MDPI study. FiveThirtyEight K=20 NBA Elo is public.

proposed_features.name: elo_win_prob_pregame
proposed_features.rationale: Direct Elo win probability as calibrated baseline feature

proposed_features.name: form_l10_diff
proposed_features.rationale: L10 momentum consistently top-3 feature across all 2025-26 studies

proposed_features.name: form_streak_pregame
proposed_features.formula: signed current streak (positive=win streak, negative=loss streak)

proposed_features.name: elo_5y_home
proposed_features.formula: exponential decay of elo over last 5 years (EWMA)
proposed_features.rationale: team_elo_5_y is top SHAP feature in MDPI 2025 CNN study achieving Brier 0.221

calibration_improvements: Track ECE (Expected Calibration Error) and MCE per cycle in live[] dict
Auto-select best calibration method via Brier: sigmoid vs isotonic vs venn_abers vs none
Add probability clipping [0.025, 0.975] to all 6 model types (already in some islands)

implementation.data_dependency: FTE Elo CSV (public, no API key) — add to vm scripts/fetch_elo.py
implementation.effort: Medium — fetch script + engine category + GA eval
implementation.expected_impact: Literature shows Elo+Form reduce Brier by 0.010-0.015 over base features

cross_repo_note: Elo differential concept also applicable to Political Alpha — policy_elo proxy from approval ratings
